Stop paying sales tax on your Alibaba inventory 👀 If you have a seller's permit (also called a resale certificate or sales tax permit), you can upload it to your Alibaba.com account and qualify for tax exempt purchases on products you plan to resell. 💸 Here's how: 1️⃣ Log into your Alibaba account 2️⃣ Go to your account settings and find Tax Information 3️⃣ Upload your seller's permit or resale certificate 4️⃣ Wait for approval, then shop wholesale tax free on qualifying orders This is one of the easiest ways to protect your profit margins when sourcing wholesale products from China for your boutique, online store, or reselling business. Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Preview on the Output Loop Bench: what it built for six real small-business tasks. A pelican riding a bicycle in the rain, a 15-second electrician promo made in Remotion, an electrician's website with a quote form, balls bouncing in a rotating hexagon (our pick), a landscaper promo and a plumbing puzzle game whose first level will not load.
